cast: hero (you, black head, blue hoodie, NO balance ever)
sam (best friend, black head, orange top)
mrs. park (cafeteria cashier, $40, ticks $40 to $44 to $48, +$4 a lunch)

script.text: You are standing in the lunch line when it happens. Above the cashier's head, a number appears. $40. It floats there, soft and white, like a price tag in the air. Nobody else looks up. Nobody else can see it. You blink. The number stays. Mrs. Park hands you your tray and takes your lunch money. Her number ticks up. $40. $44. $48. Money just moved, and you watched it move. Sam elbows you in the ribs. "You okay? You look like you saw a ghost."
